question: Which of the following shortcut key is used to repeat the last command or action, if possible, in MS-Excel 365?
solution: The correct answer is __**Ctrl + Y**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Ctrl + Y** is used to **redo the last action **in MS- Excel.​
